sites.stratum: Hyperarid red dune, sparse shrubs and a sandy walking track

reference_photos.use: Sparse vegetation, sandy approach and dune slope near the pinned path

checks: Preserve broad bare sand and sparse shrubs
Check the footpath shoulder and sand grain at grazing angles
evidence_gaps: Local wind-shaped microrelief, shrub cover and minerals within the dune sand

sites.stratum: Managed subtropical freshwater wetland with embankments and wooded margins

reference_photos.use: Water, reed and woody canopy cover in the winter wetland

checks: Separate wet shore, emergent cover and dry embankment
Keep the raised lane continuous at the water edge
evidence_gaps: Photo location within the park and managed water level at the scene time
Surface tags for the two tracks and polygon coverage of the photographed wetland
WorldCover classifies the near camera cell as cropland and the stand cell as grass

sites.stratum: Managed temperate heather and scattered junipers on sandy ground

reference_photos.use: August heather, juniper silhouettes and wooded margins in the basin

checks: Distinguish heather, grass, juniper and woodland in the managed mosaic
Check exposed sand and the soft shoulder beside low heath
evidence_gaps: Exact photo pose and site-specific burn, grazing and cutting history

sites.stratum: Subtropical freshwater marsh, limestone and a paved wetland path

reference_photos.use: Summer water and marsh plants by the pinned Anhinga Trail

checks: Check vegetation rooted at the solved shoreline
Preserve open water and keep the paved path clear
evidence_gaps: Water stage and marsh biomass at the scene time

sites.stratum: Temperate coastal dune scrub above quartz sand and exposed granite

reference_photos.use: Quartz beach, coastal scrub and rock at the nearshore path

checks: Separate quartz sand, granite and dune scrub
Check vegetation density and footing along the sheltered sand path
evidence_gaps: Tide stage and the vegetation line around the creek at the scene time
The coastal stand cell has no ecoregion or SoilGrids prior

sites.stratum: Wet-season freshwater lagoons and sparsely vegetated tropical dune sand

reference_photos.use: Seasonal lagoon, exposed sand and low cover in the Barreirinhas dune field

checks: Check relief and the extent of mapped water independently of the vegetation recipe
evidence_gaps: Exact photo pose and changing seasonal lagoon outlines and water levels
